description: This file defines an enumeration 'AgentWorkspaceConfig' with static methods for retrieving and setting a 'workspace' configuration within a nested dictionary structure in Swift. It provides utility functions to navigate and modify a configuration dictionary related to agents.

methods.name: workspace(from:)
methods.description: Retrieves the 'workspace' string from a nested configuration dictionary.

methods.name: setWorkspace(in:workspace:)
methods.description: Sets or removes the 'workspace' value within a nested mutable configuration dictionary.
